concept.title: Topic types
concept.abstract: This chapter provides an overview of DITA topic types and their role in structured, topic-based authoring. It explains the purpose, characteristics, information models, and appropriate use cases for concept, task, reference, troubleshooting, and glossary topics, enabling authors to classify content correctly and create documentation that is consistent, reusable, maintainable, and machine-processable. The chapter establishes the foundation for understanding how different information types are modeled within a DITA-based documentation architecture.

conbody.p: DITA has specific topic types for specific information. The core types include concept, task, reference, troubleshooting, and glossary. Each type has a defined structure and purpose. Using the correct topic type ensures that content is consistent, predictable, and machine processable.
